records.name: Toilets of Metronome Shopping mall/underground Passage

primary_source_evidence.notes: Mentions restroom layout and claimed afternoon use without visible report date
Jan 2026 place existence, not cruising evidence

deep_research.primary_content: FULL INDIVIDUAL SOURCE READ: Metronome ground level underground passage has TWO separate public restroom sections. Smaller near escalators: two urinals, three cubicles. Larger near fast-food outlet: six or seven urinals, four cubicles. Source alleges seasonal afternoon use and existing openings between cubicles, but these are unverified directory claims with no date. Source page displays 2 public comments on Feb 1 2025: a short visitor invitation and a blank entry, NOT current observed encounters; displayed 4 total check-ins, zero last month. Stats snapshot is page-crawl dependent, not reliable 2026 onsite activity.

original_source_map.source: Gays-Cruising individual spot 'Get Directions' driving destination link; centre-level point, NOT either exact WC room

alternatives.fact: OFFICIAL OPERATOR: Metronome at Isahakyan 22/10, corner of Isahakyan and Abovyan, 2700 m2 underground passage, escalators, cafes/fast-food, public accessible toilets, monitored 24-hour CCTV/security; lists site working hours 24h but does NOT confirm restrooms are staffed/open continuously or allowed for sex.
Independent business registry: address Yerevan Isahakyan 22/10, updated 2026-01-29; no sex-related claims.
Business directory confirms operation at same site with day/night schedule; not original WC-specific opening hours.

deep_research.location: Metronome Shopping Center underground passage, 22/10 Avetik Isahakyan Street, Kentron Yerevan, approximately 50–70 m from Yeritasardakan Metro station.
deep_research.activity: Historical/undated directory claim only; last public comments Feb 2025, outside Nov 2025-Nov 2026 window; no current activity verified. Current building/ordinary public toilets operator-supported.
deep_research.access: Operator confirms 24h security/CCTV and public toilets; source warns other ordinary public users present. No justification to infer sexual activity is permitted.
deep_research.possible_duplicates: Two restroom sections in one Metronome underground passage. Preserve two described subareas; one source candidate and do not merge their physical details into single cubicle.
outstanding: Operator does not explicitly attest current layouts of individual rooms; do not claim sighting or recent encounter.
Current behaviour still unknown, record as HISTORICAL claim.
